append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1637). PREMISE RE-TESTED on this tree: the probe failed on the first hostile blob (`blob:https://app.local/">` came back verbatim) because `new URL` treats a blob path as opaque. SHIPPED: `safeImageSrc` trims, then returns only from `if (RE.test(safe)) return safe` for five anchored, wildcard-free literals (same-origin path, raster data:image base64, percent-encoded data:image/svg+xml so a Loom site icon still previews, http(s) with an explicit path, blob:http(s)://host/). Hostile quotes, angle brackets, javascript:, vbscript:, inline SVG with onload, and protocol-relative URLs return null. A same-origin string with `..` or a space is refused rather than rewritten. No migration. `safeUploadPreviewSrc` is still a prefix filter on this helper. HYG-143 still owns the remaining CodeQL set. PROBE: failed on this tree before the change; passes here.
